text: EX-99.1 2 awhq32026pressrelease.htm EX-99.1 Document Exhibit 99.1 AWH Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results Net revenue grew 4.2% year-over-year and 3.1% sequentially to $130.0 million in Q3 2026 Generated Adjusted EBITDA 1 of $31.1 million and Adjusted EBITDA Margin 1 of 23.9%, as revenue growth drove operating leverage Ended Q3 with 56 stores and has since exceeded year-end target of 60, with 61 locations now open 2 Positive cash flow from operations of $5.4 million, after the $19.1 million semi-annual interest payment NEW YORK, November 12, 2026 – Ascend Wellness Holdings, Inc. (“AWH,” “Ascend,” or the “Company”) (CSE: AAWH-U.CN) (OTCQX:AAWH), a multi-state, vertically integrated cannabis operator and consumer packaged goods company, today reported its financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 (“Q3 2026”). Financial results are reported in accordance with U.S. generally accepted accounting principles (“GAAP”), and all currency is in U.S. dollars. Q3 2026 Financial Highlights • Net revenue was $130.0 million compared to $126.1 million in the second quarter of 2026 (“Q2 2026”), an increase of 3.1% sequentially and 4.2% year-over-year. ◦ Retail revenue was $97.8 million compared to $92.7 million in Q2 2026, an increase of 5.5% sequentially, and represented 75.2% of total net revenue, up from 73.5%. ◦ Wholesale revenue was $32.2 million compared to $33.4 million in Q2 2026. • Adjusted Gross Profit Margin 1 of 48.4% of revenue compared to 46.2% in Q2 2026. • Adjusted EBITDA 1 was $31.1 million compared to $29.1 million in Q2 2026, representing an Adjusted EBITDA Margin 1 of 23.9%. • Net cash provided by operating activities was $5.4 million, inclusive of the Company’s $19.1 million semi-annual interest payment, compared to net cash used in operating activities of $2.0 million in the third quarter of 2025 (“Q3 2025”). • Cash and cash equivalents of $63.6 million as of September 30, 2026. Q3 2026 Business and Operational Highlights • Reached 56 retail stores in Q3 2026, including partner owned and operated locations. • Increased total retail transactions by 6.0% sequentially and 14.9% year-over-year to approximately 1.7 million, the most of any quarter in the Company’s history. ◦ Transactions across the Company’s New Jersey locations, including partners, increased 18% sequentially and 37% year-over-year. 1 • Maintained its position as the number two brand house by both sales and units across the Company’s core markets of Illinois, New Jersey, and Massachusetts, on a combined basis, according to BDSA 3 . ◦ Ozone held the number three position in dollar share and number one in units across those markets, and the Company’s share in New Jersey increased approximately 14% sequentially. • Launched 103 new products in Q3 2026, including the new Ozone Signature premium flower lineup. • Drove new customer growth and deepened engagement across the Company’s network: ◦ New customer traffic increased 19% sequentially across retail footprint; ◦ Loyalty members accounted for more than 86% of transactions during the quarter, and approximately 32% of new customers enrolled in Ascend’s loyalty program; and ◦ Pay by bank adoption (Ascend Pay) reached 11.4% of transactions in Q3 2026. • Received stockholder approval for a reverse stock split of the Company’s Class A common shares. This approval, voted on at a special meeting on August 28, 2026, gives the Company’s board of directors flexibility to set the ratio and timing of the split. The Company intends to use it to support a potential listing on a major U.S. exchange, subject to regulatory developments, including broader cannabis rescheduling. Recent Developments • Opened five new dispensaries across core markets, including partner owned and operated locations, bringing the total retail footprint to 61 stores and exceeding the year-end target of 60 ahead of schedule. New openings include: ◦ Ascend of Evesham in Marlton, New Jersey, which the Company owns and operates with a social equity partner. Two additional partner stores in the Company’s New Jersey pipeline are expected to open in early 2027, subject to regulatory timing. ◦ Ascend Lewis Center, Ohio, the Company’s seventh store in the state. ◦ A partner-owned and operated dispensary opened in Plano, Illinois in November, bringing the Company’s retail footprint in the state to 17 locations, including partners. ◦ Two dispensaries in Worcester and Shrewsbury, Massachusetts, which the Company began operating in October under a consulting agreement pending regulatory approval to close the acquisition. Upon closing, Ascend will gain a vertically integrated medical license, which it expects to extend to all of its Massachusetts stores and its Athol cultivation facility, allowing each of its stores in the state to serve medical patients. 2 • Expanded retail footprint from 39 to 61 stores 2 since August 2024, a net increase of approximately 60% in just over two years, driven by the Company’s retail densification strategy. • Debuted Effin’ Tabs, a line of precision-dosed THC tablets and a new format for the brand, in New Jersey, Massachusetts, and Illinois. • Closed $11 million in non-dilutive mortgage loans with CF Bank, secured by five Company-owned properties in Illinois, Maryland, and Massachusetts. The loans carry an 8.5% annual interest rate and mature in October 2031, and the Company intends to use the proceeds to support retail expansion and pursue accretive acquisition opportunities. • Entered into a capital-light brand licensing agreement with Atlantic Cultivation, a Canadian craft cannabis producer. Through this arrangement, select products from two of the Company’s flagship brands, High Wired infused pre-rolls and Ozone Liquid Diamonds vapes, are expected to reach Canadian shelves in the first quarter of 2027. Management Commentary “Our growth strategy continues to drive results across the business, and that momentum carried through a strong third quarter as we delivered on the goals we set,” said Sam Brill, CEO & Director of AWH. “Net revenue returned to year-over-year growth despite continued pricing headwinds, and retail sales grew as a share of total revenue. Since quarter end, we also exceeded our year-end target of 60 stores ahead of schedule. That is a milestone, not a finish line, and we see ample room to keep growing our retail footprint through our densification strategy. On the brand side, Ascend remains the number two brand house across Illinois, New Jersey, and Massachusetts, combined, and we recently signed a licensing agreement to bring our brands to Canada, our first market outside of the U.S. and one of the most sophisticated and competitive cannabis markets in the world.” Frank Perullo, Founder, President & Director of AWH, added, “Sustained investment in our operations has meaningfully improved product quality across our portfolio, and it is showing up in our market share and in our revenue per gram. Each new retail door extends our consumer reach, strengthens our brands and market share positioning, and adds additional operating leverage by driving more vertical sales. All of that supports consistent cash flow generation, which remains a core goal for us in both the near term and the long term.” “Scale and profitability are moving together, and our focus on cash discipline is showing up in the results,” said Roman Nemchenko, Chief Financial Officer. “We generated $5.4 million of cash flow from operations in the third quarter while also funding our $19.1 million semi-annual interest payment, a $7.4 million improvement from the third quarter of last year. Lean working capital, continuous cost management, and driving more sales through our retail channel were the largest contributors, and we expect retail growth to be a meaningful source of Adjusted EBITDA 1 and cash flow growth into 2027.” 3 Q3 2026 Financial Overview Net revenue totaled $130.0 million for Q3 2026, an increase of 3.1% sequentially from $126.1 million in [truncated]
summary: Ascend opened five new dispensaries, including Marlton NJ, Lewis Center OH, and Plano IL, bringing its retail footprint to 61 stores.

text: EX-99.2 3 exhibit992projectarisepres.htm EX-99.2 Document Exhibit 99.2 Contacts: Media Adam Kress (602) 760-6252 Adam.Kress@honeywellaerospace.com Honeywell Aerospace to build new state-of-the-art manufacturing facility in Arizona to support growing commercial and defense demand New facility planned for Tempe campus will create approximately 600 jobs, and support current and next-generation aviation technologies and high-priority defense programs PHOENIX, October 28, 2026 – Honeywell Aerospace (NASDAQ: HONA) today announced a major expansion of its manufacturing facilities, strengthening the company's ability to meet growing demand across current and next-generation commercial aviation and defense programs. The new $500 million, 300,000 square foot Tempe, Arizona facility will include an integrated digital production system, modular robotics, automated inspection, digital twins, and be powered by an end-to-end digital thread. This Honeywell Aerospace from-the-ground-up manufacturing facility investment will support the largest commercial and defense customers in aerospace and defense. "Demand for Honeywell Aerospace technologies continues to accelerate across both commercial and defense markets, and this major investment ensures we can continue delivering for our customers while unlocking long-term growth for our shareholders," said Jim Currier, president and chief executive officer of Honeywell Aerospace. “This is an example of how our recent spin into an independent, publicly-traded Honeywell Aerospace allows us to make decisions and investments that support our growth and the future of aviation and defense.” The new facility, near the company’s global headquarters, will create supply chain resilience by adding internal complex machining capability – a key area of the supply base that is currently constrained – while establishing a more vertically integrated production system for the next generation of products including Assure advanced actuation systems and Attune vapor cycle cooling subsystems. Opening in late 2028, the advanced manufacturing facility will support customers’ growth on current programs, $15 billion in Control Systems new program wins, and the future of aviation. The expansion will also provide critical capacity growth to support priority production of critical defense technologies included in the supplier framework agreement the company signed with the Department of War in March. The facility will create approximately 600 jobs, increasing the company’s engineering depth and its skilled workforce. "Arizona has been at the heart of our innovation and manufacturing operations for decades,” Currier continued. “Expanding on our existing Tempe campus with this state-of-the-art new facility reinforces our commitment to this great state, our employees and the Arizona workforce, as well as the customers around the world who depend on Honeywell Aerospace technologies every day." ### About Honeywell Aerospace Honeywell Aerospace (Nasdaq: HONA) is an independent global aerospace and defense company whose critical technologies are broadly deployed on the world’s leading commercial air transport, business aviation, defense and space platforms. These integrated solutions enable safer, more efficient and more reliable missions. Headquartered in Phoenix, Arizona, the company employs more than 36,000 people globally and supports more than 10,000 customers. With a broad portfolio spanning avionics and navigation systems, engines and power systems, and control systems for aircraft, Honeywell Aerospace combines commitment and deep engineering expertise to drive innovation and long-term value for the aerospace industry. For more information, visit www.honeywellaerospace.com or follow Honeywell Aerospace on LinkedIn Forward-looking statements The discussions in the release contain forward-looking statements within the meaning of Section 27A of the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, and Section 21E of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the "Exchange Act"). Forward-looking statements are those that address activities, events, or developments that management intends, expects, projects, believes, estimates, forecasts, or anticipates will or may occur in the future. They are based on management's assumptions and assessments in light of past experience and trends, current economic and industry conditions, expected future developments, customer demand, and other relevant factors, many of which are difficult to predict and outside of our control. These forward-looking statements should be considered in light of the information included in this release with our filings with the Securities and Exchange Commission. text: EX-99.1 2 mlr-ex99d1.htm EX-99.1 I Exhibit 99.1 ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ 8503 Hilltop Drive, Ooltewah, TN 37363 Telephone (423) 238-4171 ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ CONTACT: Miller Industries, Inc. ​ ​ Debbie Whitmire, Chief Financial Officer (423) 238-8464 ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ FTI Consulting, Inc. ​ ​ Mike Gaudreau millerind@fticonsulting.com ​ MILLER INDUSTRIES REPORTS 2026 THIRD QUARTER RESULTS ​ Solid Year-Over-Year Revenue Growth Driven by Consistent Production and Demand ​ Expanded Product Offering with Recent Introduction of 65-ton Rotator ​ Board of Directors Approves Dividend of $0.21 per Share ​ On Track to Achieve Full-Year 2026 Revenue and Earnings Guidance ​ CHATTANOOGA, Tennessee, November 4, 2026/PRNewswire/ -- Miller Industries, Inc. (NYSE: MLR) (“Miller Industries” or the “Company”) today announced financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, and provided updates on its global strategic initiatives. ​ Q3 2026 Financial Results vs. Q3 2025 · Revenue: $212.2 million, an 18.8% increase from $178.7 million · Gross Profit: $29.8 million, a 17.6% increase from $25.3 million · Gross Margin: 14.0%, a decrease of approximately 20 basis points from 14.2% · SG&A Expenses: $22.0 million, a 3.5% increase from $21.2 million · Net Income: $6.1 million, a 97.2% increase from $3.1 million · Diluted EPS: $0.53 per share, an increase of 96.3% from $0.27 per diluted share ​ Third Quarter Business Highlights · Delivered solid year-over-year revenue growth as the Company maintained production in line with steady order intake in a dynamic environment. · Generated strong cash flow, enabling the return of $5.1 million to shareholders in the form of dividends and share repurchases, and continued investment in the business. · Heavy-duty capacity expansion at Ooltewah remains on schedule, with initial building construction underway. · Continuing to innovate the Company’s product line; recently introduced the new 65-ton rotator (the Century M65) at an event attended by more than 1,000 global distributors and customers. · Remain on track to achieve full-year 2026 revenue and earnings per share guidance. ​ “We are pleased to have delivered solid year-over-year revenue growth in the third quarter,” said William G. Miller II, Chief Executive Officer. “We’ve seen no slowdown in customer demand, and our order intake remains consistent. While the quarter was impacted by planned holiday downtime and production challenges among our chassis suppliers, the underlying strength in demand for our products gives us confidence as we move into the final quarter of 2026, and into 2027.” ​ Mr. Miller continued, “More importantly, we have continued to generate cash at an impressive rate throughout the year, enabling us to not only return capital directly to our shareholders through our industry-leading dividend and our share repurchase program, but also to invest in our long-term growth. In addition to our ongoing capacity expansion in Ooltewah, we recently hosted more than 1,000 global distributors and customers in Chattanooga to showcase the Century M65. By continuing to prioritize our people, our products, and the health of our distribution network, we remain well positioned to finish the year on a strong note and deliver on our full year 2026 outlook.” ​ Omars Update Omars delivered solid performance, including significant year-over-year growth, reinforcing confidence that the acquisition remains on track to meet the Company’s expectations for first-year accretion. Separately, non-cash acquisition-related items had a positive impact of approximately $0.09 per diluted share based on the final third-party valuation. These items primarily reflected equipment adjustments to fair market value, amortization of the estimated intangible value of customer relationships, and the associated tax amortization benefit. Most of the expenses related to the Company’s acquisition and integration of Omars were recognized in the first and second quarters of 2026. ​ Ooltewah, TN Manufacturing Capacity Expansion To support future growth, European demand, and defense production commitments, Miller Industries previously announced the addition of a new 200,000+ sq ft facility at its Ooltewah headquarters site, at a cost of approximately $100 million. Miller Industries anticipates funding the majority of this expansion through operating cash flow over the next several years. ​ This expansion is intended to: 1. Increase Overall Production Capacity and Efficiency · As distributor inventories have returned to historical levels, the Company plans to maintain production volumes through the end of 2026 to meet anticipated steady retail activity. · The new facility will significantly expand output capacity to meet growing domestic and international demand and reinforce Miller Industries as the global leader in the heavy ‑ duty recovery market. · In particular, the expansion will increase output capacity for heavy ‑ duty recovery units, which remain the Company’s largest global export. 2. Support European Demand Through U.S. Backfill, Integrated Capacity, and Regional Expansion · U.S. production will continue to serve as a critical backbone for European demand. Together, the addition of Omars, the expansion of Jige’s heavy ‑ duty integration facility, and production enhancements at the Company’s Boniface facility will help ensure production stability, improved lead times, and a fully integrated global supply strategy. 3. Prepare for Higher-Volume Global Military Production · Military commitments currently exceed $200 million, and additional global RFQs are underway. The new facility will be capable of supporting higher-volume global defense ‑ grade recovery vehicle production for global military programs. · Military programs production is scheduled to begin in 2027 and accelerate into 2028 and 2029, requiring enhanced capacity, specialized equipment, and advanced production flow capabilities. ​ Return of Capital to Shareholders The Company’s Board of Directors approved a quarterly cash dividend of $0.21 per share, payable December 14, 2026, to shareholders of record as of December 7, 2026. This represents the sixty-fourth consecutive quarter that Miller Industries has paid a dividend. Separately, the Company repurchased approximately $2.7 million of stock during the third quarter of 2026 under the Company’s stock repurchase program. ​ 2026 Guidance and Production Outlook The Company is re-affirming its previously issued revenue guidance of $850 million to $900 million for full year 2026 and expects earnings per share to be generally in line with full year 2025 results. ​ Miller Industries expects production volumes to remain steady through the end of 2026. For the full year, gross margins are now expected to be  approximately 14%, higher than previously anticipated, reflecting a lower mix of chassis. In the fourth quarter, revenue mix is expected to return toward historical levels of bodies and chassis. ​ The statements in the 2026 guidance and production outlook provided above are forward looking. Actual results may differ materially. See our cautionary note regarding “forward-looking statements” below. ​ Conference Call The Company will host a conference call, which will be simultaneously broadcast live over the Internet. The call is scheduled for tomorrow, November 5, 2026, at 10:00 AM ET. Listeners can access the conference call live and archived over the Internet through the following link: ​ https://app.webinar.net/k8KEn3m1Gq7 ​ Please allow 15 minutes prior to the call to visit the site, download, and install any necessary audio software. A replay of this call will be available approximately one hour after the live call ends through Thursday, November 19, 2026. The replay number is 1-844-512-2921 , Passcode 1148648. ​ About Miller Industries, Inc. Miller Industries is The World’s Largest Manufacturer of Towing and Recovery Equipment®, and markets its towing and recovery equipment under a number of well-recognized brand [truncated]
summary: Miller Industries reports ongoing construction of a 200,000+ sq ft, roughly $100 million heavy-duty manufacturing expansion at its Ooltewah headquarters site.

text: EX-99.1 2 ex_1038216.htm EXHIBIT 99.1 ex_1038216.htm Exhibit 99.1 ACADIA HEALTHCARE ANNOUNCES THIRD QUARTER 2026 RESULTS AND RAISES FULL YEAR 2026 FINANCIAL GUIDANCE FRANKLIN, Tenn. (November 4, 2026 ) – Acadia Healthcare Company, Inc. (“Acadia” or the “Company”) (NASDAQ: ACHC) today announced financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. Third Quarter 2026 Results ● Revenue totaled $895.3 million, an increase of 5.1% compared with the third quarter of 2025 ● Same-facility revenue increased 5.2% compared with the third quarter of 2025, as patient days increased 1.1% and revenue per patient day increased 4.0% ● Net income attributable to Acadia totaled $34.5 million, or $0.38 per diluted share, compared with $36.2 million, or $0.40 per diluted share, in the prior-year period ● Adjusted net income attributable to Acadia totaled $54.6 million, or $0.60 per diluted share, compared with $64.8 million, or $0.72 per diluted share, in the prior-year period ● Adjusted EBITDA was $176.4 million, compared with $173.0 million in the prior-year period ● Operating cash flows were $97.9 million and capital expenditures were $50.7 million ● Added 220 licensed beds during the third quarter, including 144 beds at a new facility and 76 beds at existing facilities Adjusted net income attributable to Acadia, Adjusted EBITDA and Adjusted earnings per diluted share are non-GAAP financial measures. A reconciliation of all non-GAAP financial measures in this press release begins on page 9. “Acadia delivered strong results in the third quarter, and our positive momentum is driving our increased full-year guidance. We remain focused on our key priorities, including expanding access to quality patient care and consistent operational execution with financial discipline," said Debbie Osteen, Chief Executive Officer of Acadia. "We've expanded our footprint by opening 16 new acute facilities over the last four years, and based on the progress we've made so far this year, we now expect to deliver approximately $60 million of incremental EBITDA from these facilities in 2027 relative to 2026.
